resources.string: On the Mac, open the pairing page the Twelve server prints at startup (http://127.0.0.1:7712/pair) and paste one of the links shown under the QR code. No scanner here on purpose: paste is enough.
That does not look like a server link. It should start with http:// and include the Mac address and port, for example http://192.168.1.20:7712/?token=…
